label: Beginner · Lesson 8
title: He is, she is, it is
intro: He, she, it and countries. Today’s words and grammar, and what we learnt before.
intro_uz: He, she, it va davlatlar. Bugungi so’zlar, grammatika va oldingi mavzular.
message: Beginner · Lesson 8 · He is, she is, it is. Do it before the next lesson. Rasmga oling yoki chop eting.

parts.title: He, she, it · am, is, are
items: Lola is a teacher. {He|She} is from Bukhara.
This is a pen. {He|It} is blue.

parts.title: Write the word
parts.uz: So’zni yozing: he, she, is, am, city…
items: Madina is from Samarkand. ___ is a student.
Tom is from England. ___ is a teacher.
Tashkent is a ___. It is in Uzbekistan.

items.prompt: Write 4 sentences about a friend: name, job, city or country.
items.hint: Example: Aziz is my friend. He is a student. He is 14. He is from Bukhara.
